title: 第1章 这是哪第2章 出任务
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
噼噼啪啪……
一个青年兴奋的打着游戏，如果细看你会发现，他只是打着简单的单机游戏。这要被其他游戏玩家看到，肯定会心里默默的说‘菜鸟’！可这青年却不厌其烦的玩着，没有留意已经凌晨三点多了。
孙云是个孤儿，自小被一个孤寡老人收养。但命中注定他不是天才，和大多孩子一样努力的读书，却顶多算班级里前十名。
高中没毕业，就因为老人的病情加重辍学了，走上了就业之路。工地、工厂、杂工、小贩等，他都去认真的做每一件事情。
凭着自己勤劳，而又乐观的心态，也算步入了小康生活。但随着老人的去世，他又过上了孤苦伶仃的日子。
在外人看来，他乐观向上，有房有车，是个好青年。但有谁能体会他的孤独，他多么渴望能找到所谓的归属感。
慢慢的，孙云趴在书桌上，皱着眉头的睡着了。他不玩大型游戏，不是因为他不喜欢，是他怕上瘾。孤单的他，一天不工作，就会面临房贷追款，甚至饿肚子的处境。
…………
天有不测风云，人又旦夕祸福，悲催的他一觉醒来，世界竟然变了，万物生长的都异常高大。他以为自己是在做梦，转身倒头又睡，是一如既往的心大啊！
可突然屁股一疼!“又偷懒，赶路了！”
旁边一个比他高大许多的怪物看着他！吓的他赶快起来，往后退，这什么鬼，吓死宝宝了！
“集合，你给我快点！”
本着做梦，就得顺其自然的态度，孙云迷迷糊糊的跟着走出去了。但是，慢慢的发现自己走路不正常了，仿佛多了点什么！
好像旁边的哥们，长的像大蚂蚁，这家伙太大了！不对，我好像和他们一伙的，也是蚂蚁？
这梦做的太奇怪了，明天要查查周公解梦，看看是不是要发财的预兆。也许是要命犯桃花了，说不定自己马上就能脱离高龄单身的命运，孙云狠狠的想！
怎么还不醒？
孙云开始有些急躁了，边走边掐自己，可是皮太厚，没啥作用。这梦做的有点久了，怎么还没完？而且这也太枯燥无味了，总是走路，这都不带歇脚的么？孙云越来越不耐烦，越来越感觉不对劲，自己不会是穿越了吧？
“嗨，哥们，你揍我一下呗！”孙云拍拍前面的蚂蚁道！他突然发现，自己掐自己好像不现实，谁舍得对自己使劲啊！
碰……嘭……
孙云被一爪击飞，直接撞到一块石头上。强烈的疼痛感，让孙云不由自主的呲牙咧嘴，到没有受什么伤。

“神经病！”打他的蚂蚁歧视的看着孙云！
不会吧，真的穿越了？
我勒了个去，别人都成个贵族少爷，兽族太子啥的！戒指、功法、美女、再来个传奇老头师傅看中自己天分，怎么自己甚么都没有?那个日啊，干啊，擦啊……
轰隆……
突然，一阵怪异的记忆，在孙云有些激动的时候，冲进脑子里。孙云一个眩晕，直接倒在了地上！
“哎哎，兄弟没事吧！”
content_en:
Crack, crackle...
A young man is playing the game excitedly. If you look closely, you will find that he is just playing a simple stand-alone game. If other gamers saw this, they would definitely say ‘rookie’ in their hearts! But this young man was playing tirelessly and didn't notice that it was already past three in the morning.
Sun Yun is an orphan who was adopted by a lonely old man since he was a child. But it is destined that he is not a genius. He studies as hard as most children, but at most he is ranked among the top ten in the class.
Before graduating from high school, he dropped out of school because the old man's condition worsened and embarked on the road to employment. He does everything seriously at construction sites, factories, handymen, vendors, etc.
With his hard work and optimistic attitude, he has entered a well-off life. But with the death of the old man, he once again lived a lonely life.
In the eyes of outsiders, he is optimistic, has a house and a car, and is a good young man. But who can understand his loneliness and how much he longs to find the so-called sense of belonging.
Slowly, Sun Yun lay on the desk and fell asleep with a frown on his face. He doesn't play big games, not because he doesn't like it, but because he's afraid of getting addicted. Lonely, if he doesn't work for a day, he will face mortgage debt collection and even starvation.
…………
The sky is unpredictable, and people are prone to misfortune and misfortune. When he wakes up sadly, the world has changed, and everything is growing unusually tall. He thought he was dreaming, turned around and fell back to sleep. He was as big-hearted as ever!
But suddenly my butt hurt! "I'm lazy again, I'm on my way!"
Next to him, a monster much taller than him looked at him! He was so frightened that he quickly got up and stepped back. What the hell is this? It scared the baby to death!
"Gather, hurry up!"
In line with the attitude of letting nature take its course when dreaming, Sun Yun followed him out in a daze. However, I gradually discovered that I was not walking normally, as if there was something extra!
It seems that the guy next to me looks like a big ant. This guy is too big! No, I seem to be with them, are they also ants?
This dream is so strange. I will check Duke Zhou’s dream interpretation tomorrow to see if it is a sign of getting rich. Maybe it was because of a fatal mistake, maybe he would be able to escape the fate of being single at an advanced age soon, Sun Yun thought fiercely!
Why aren't you awake yet?
Sun Yun started to get a little impatient and pinched himself as he walked, but his skin was too thick and it had no effect. I've had this dream for a while, why isn't it over yet? And it’s too boring. You’re always walking, and don’t you have a place to rest? Sun Yun became increasingly impatient and felt something was wrong. Could it be that he had traveled through time?
"Hey, buddy, you can beat me up!" Sun Yun said, patting the ant in front of him! He suddenly realized that it was unrealistic to pinch himself. Who would be willing to use force on himself?
Bump...bang...
Sun Yun was knocked away by a claw and hit a rock directly. The intense pain made Sun Yun grin involuntarily, but he was not injured at all.
"Crazy!" The ant who hit him looked at Sun Yun discriminatoryly!
No way, have you really traveled through time?
I strangled him, and everyone else became an aristocratic young master, an orc prince, or something like that! Rings, exercises, beauties, and a legendary old master took a fancy to my talent, but why did I have nothing? That day, I did it, I rubbed it...
Boom...
Suddenly, a strange memory rushed into Sun Yun's mind when he was a little excited. Sun Yun was dizzy and fell to the ground!
"Hey, brother, are you okay?"
